It moves me to TEARS!|audio = Narrator3Act1.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[A Dark Tale]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Citizen Plush''' was the sixth and second enemy that appeared in the [[Lunar Overture Event]], in the [[A Dark Tale|first]] and [[The Great Finale|third act]], respectively. It had a decent amount of health for its debut, which depended on the act it appeared in. ==Appearance== The '''Citizen Plush''' was a humanoid made of plush fabric. It had a tan skin color, a khaki shirt, dark brown pants and a khaki hat. It also had black buttons for its eyes and a stitched khaki mouth. ==Strategy== *Cheap and high DPS towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] can kill it easily. *More expensive yet high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are highly effective against it. **Towers with the capability to damage chains of enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]] or [[Pyromancer]], are also extremely useful against this enemy. *Due to all your towers being sold in the [[A Dark Tale|first act's]] transition, make sure your defense is replaced as fast as possible as these enemies come in very quickly. ==Trivia== *Its appearance is based on the [[Citizen 1]] and [[Citizen 2]] units that appeared in the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. *Unlike all other enemies in [[A Dark Tale]], the '''Citizen Plush''' does not give cash equal or higher to its health when killed or damaged enough, as the amount given is lower than its health by 20. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Citizen Plush''' added. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **'''Citizen Plush''' now appears in [[The Great Finale]]. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Citizen Plush''' removed. {{ADarkTale|[[Swamper]]|Wave 8|Citizen Plush|Wave 10|[[Knight (Lunar Overture)|Knight]]|Wave 12}} {{TheGreatFinale|[[Actor1 (Lunar Overture)|Actor1]]|Wave 1|Citizen Plush|Wave 2|[[Knight (Lunar Overture)|Knight]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Citizen Plush}}
